prompt: What is 'fitness sharing' used for in genetic algorithms?
choices: Distributing the fitness computation across multiple threads
Penalizing individuals in overcrowded regions of the search space to promote diversity
Sharing the best fitness across all individuals equally
Averaging the fitness of parent and offspring
explanation: Fitness sharing reduces the effective fitness of individuals that are similar to many others. This maintains population diversity and helps GAs explore multiple niches (local optima) simultaneously. It prevents the GA from converging entirely on one region of the search space.
